FreezeTag is free, open source, and extensible image storage solution that is designed to give you the power to choose your workflow. Whether you just need basic storage and tagging capabilities, or powerful machine-learning features, or integration with external applications, FreezeTag can help you accomplish your goals.

FreezeTag was developed as a Computer Science Capstone Project at the University of Utah in the 2025-2026 school year, and is actively maintained by the original developers.

Access the documentation here to get started.
